contract: RequirementEvidence(id, implementation, gui, persist, reopen, failure, handoff, platform, target, prerequisites)
rules: One record per legacy ID of docs/service-upgrade-program.json legacy_coverage (F001-F123, U001-U033); fields: id, the seven dimensions, platform (windows_native required) and prerequisites (texts); no other fields.

Each dimension is pending, verified (with evidence) or not_required (a reason of at least 10 characters and its reviewer). implementation and platform.windows_native can never be not_required. A legacy claim of the old registries is never evidence.

Evidence entry: task, source_sha (full 40 characters), kind, action, expected, observed, reviewer, and a test (an exact-case repository test path, optionally ::case; Python selectors must declare a test function in the AST) or a receipt (a plain name) with receipt_sha256; optional artifacts [{id, sha256}]; no other fields.

Kinds and what they cite: gui needs click, an exact scripts/e2e spec::case and a hashed GUI execution receipt; target needs target, a hashed receipt and the run artifacts; platform.windows_native needs native_windows, a hashed receipt or a test the Windows workflow runs. Every evidence dimension requires a task owning the feature. A receipt must be retained under docs/verification/receipts, be a regular unlinked unique-key JSON object of at most 1 MiB, match the cited SHA-256 and contain the same source_sha. These checks establish reference integrity, not action truth, historic-source execution, independent approval or model quality.
A clicked button, a finished job and an approved quality are separate evidence; model quality and operations approval are not implied by any of these dimensions.

A legacy row is accepted only when every dimension is verified or not_required and platform.windows_native is verified; scripts/check_service_plan.py derives it, checks the program row and the main table of docs/service-upgrade-coverage.md, and refuses any other claim.

Click evidence requires an exact scripts/e2e/spec.ts::case and a retained modu-vision.gui-execution/v1 receipt. One expected passed attempt on a clean full commit, current spec SHA-256, actual browser/Electron platform and report/harness/screenshot hashes are required. File-only, skipped, retried, changed-source or expected-failure references do not verify execution. The collector checks the historical Git test bytes; the registry gate checks the retained current test bytes. Root-reviewed receipts do not grant independent review, action semantics, model quality or target approval.
